text: {"1366":{"about":["rustc_trait_selection"],"refers":[],"why":"The trait-resolution implementation deliberately verifies selection during type checking without retaining selected results."},"1367":{"about":["rustc_trait_selection"],"refers":[],"why":"This describes the trait-selection phase's type-checking goal of confirming that selection succeeds."},"1368":{"about":["rustc_traits","rustc_monomorphize"],"refers":[],"why":"Codegen-time candidate selection is provided by rustc_traits, while monomorphization generates the selected concrete implementation."},"1369":{"about":["rustc_trait_selection"],"refers":[],"why":"This defines selection as a principal part of the trait-resolution system implemented by rustc_trait_selection."},"1370":{"about":["rustc_trait_selection"],"refers":[],"why":"Choosing a matching impl or parameter bound is behavior of trait selection."}}
